cover.title: 1,000 people saw it in one week

lines.text: There's a forest in New Jersey... where people have been seeing the same thing for almost three hundred years.
The Pine Barrens. Over a million acres of pine forest in South Jersey.
The legend starts in 1735, near Leeds Point. A woman known as Mother Leeds already had twelve children... and she was pregnant again.
The story says she cried out... let this one be the devil.
On a stormy night, the baby was born. Then it changed. Hooves. Wings. A tail. And it flew up the chimney... into the pines.
For almost two hundred years, it was just a story people told in the woods.
For one week, newspapers printed hundreds of sightings. Hoof prints in the snow... across rooftops. Schools closed. Factories shut down. People stayed home.
On January eighteenth, it was reported in Camden.
Historians call it mass hysteria. But people in the Pines... still report it today.
If you grew up in South Jersey, you've heard about it. Comment your town... and sleep tight, partner.
